subject: Hawthorne
fact: Hawthorne is the second son of the Elder who observed the trio's movements from the moathouse and followed them to Jaroo, Terjon, Burne, and Refus, driven by natural curiosity.
source_quote: My second son, Hawthorne, saw you come from the moathouse. He followed you and saw you visited Jaroo, Terjon, Burne, and Refus.

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler is a council member whom the trio has already met, and who has offered a job to prove Furnoc is a crook who steals from the Inn’s guests, with free rooms as incentive.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met...

subject: Furnok the Fabulous
fact: Furnok the Fabulous is a target of Ostler’s accusation of theft from Inn guests; his pickpocketing attempt fails, and he is later confronted by Ostler, who discovers loaded dice.
source_quote: his attempt at pick-pocketing Furnok the Fabulous fails... he realizes they are loaded—'The proof I needed!'

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo is the son of Zeb Fletcher, a drunk adventurer and ranger who is sitting at the Inn, and who volunteers to help the trio find the monster in the Gnarley Forest.
source_quote: Sequoia realizes that this is Elmo. He also smells the stench of booze on him: 'A drunk.'... Elmo is an adventurer and a ranger by profession.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir is a mysterious figure who claims knowledge of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows and offers to join the trio as a fourth member in exchange for first pick of arcane scrolls.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows... I would like to go adventuring with you and complete your quartet.

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey is the son of Virgil Tamen, the Braumeister, who reports seeing cloaked figures near the brewery at midnight and fears the temple may not be dead, prompting the trio to investigate.
source_quote: I'm the son of Virgil Tamen, the Braumeister... I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: Zeb Fletcher
fact: Zeb Fletcher is the father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller, and a council member whose influence is referenced by a patron threatening to call him.
source_quote: Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller... 'I’ll have to call the Captain, and he won’t be as kindly as Ostler is.'

subject: Valsenora
fact: Valsenora is Kenter’s wife, who brings treats to the table during the Elder’s gathering, symbolizing hospitality and community.
source_quote: the treats that Kenter’s wife, Valsenora, brings to the table.

subject: The Council
fact: The Council consists of Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, with Captain Zeb Fletcher as a key figure; they are the governing body of the village and the target of the Elder’s influence.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler... Captain Zeb Fletcher... the people you spoke to are on the council.

subject: The Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse is the location from which Hawthorne first observed the trio’s arrival and began following them, suggesting it is a point of surveillance or transition.
source_quote: Hawthorne, saw you come from the moathouse.

subject: The Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: The Inn of the Welcome Wench is where Ostler greets the trio, Furnok is accused, Elmo is encountered, and the secret passage beneath the inn is rumored to exist.
source_quote: the Inn of the Welcome Wench... greets the trio at the door... the secret passage below the inn...

subject: The Brewery
fact: The Brewery is the site of suspicious activity reported by Mickey, where cloaked figures are seen at midnight, sparking the trio’s investigation.
source_quote: cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: Emiry Meadows
fact: Emiry Meadows is the rumored location of a lost wizard laboratory, as disclosed by Spugnoir, who offers to guide the trio there.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.

subject: The Gnarley Forest
fact: The Gnarley Forest is the location of a rumored monster, which Elmo volunteers to help the trio find.
source_quote: There is a monster in the Gnarley forest, and we will need someone to help us find it.

subject: The Ruined Boathouse
fact: The Ruined Boathouse is the destination desired by Lysia, the farmer’s daughter, who needs equipment and companions to explore it.
source_quote: a farmer's daughter, Lysia, is itching to explore the ruined boathouse...

subject: The Castle Construction Site
fact: The Castle Construction Site is noted by Sequoia for its unusually loud noise during the quiet night, suggesting ongoing hidden activity or magical interference.
source_quote: Sequoia notices how much noise the castle construction makes.

subject: Furnok’s Dice Discovery
fact: Ostler’s attempt to catch Furnok stealing fails, but the loaded dice found during the failed pickpocketing become proof of a deeper conspiracy.
source_quote: he realizes they are loaded—'The proof I needed!'

subject: Elmo Joins the Group
fact: Elmo, a drunken but capable ranger, volunteers to join the trio’s quest to find the monster in the Gnarley Forest, becoming an informal ally.
source_quote: I am your person!

subject: Spugnoir Joins the Quartet
fact: Spugnoir offers to join the trio as a fourth adventurer, revealing knowledge of a lost wizard lab and demanding first pick of scrolls, surprising them with familiarity.
source_quote: Somehow, you are very familiar... Sure.

subject: Mickey’s Report
fact: Mickey reports cloaked figures near the brewery at midnight, raising fears that the temple may be active again, prompting the trio to investigate under cover of night.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: Night Surveillance at the Brewery
fact: The trio sneaks out at midnight to observe the brewery, with Zephyr confronting two cloaked spies, one of whom is captured with a blade to the throat.
source_quote: Zephyr quickly advances on them... puts the blade to the throat of the smaller of the two—the spy shrieks.

subject: The Monster in the Gnarley Forest
fact: A mysterious monster is rumored to inhabit the Gnarley Forest, and Elmo claims he is the person to help the trio find it.
source_quote: There is a monster in the Gnarley forest...

subject: The Loaded Dice
fact: The loaded dice found on Furnok are physical evidence of fraud or magical manipulation, and serve as the key proof Ostler seeks.
source_quote: he realizes they are loaded—'The proof I needed!'

subject: The Secret Passage Beneath the Inn
fact: A secret passage beneath the Inn of the Welcome Wench is rumored to lead to four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard, suggesting hidden history and potential treasure.
source_quote: There is a secret passage below the inn that leads to an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.

subject: The Temple’s Possible Resurgence
fact: Rumors suggest the temple may not be dead, and the cloaked figures at the brewery may be spies, creating an unresolved mystery the trio must investigate.
source_quote: the rumors around the village is going that the temple isn't as dead as everybody thought. And so maybe, those are, uh, spies.

subject: Spugnoir’s Familiarity
fact: Spugnoir’s uncanny familiarity with the trio raises an unresolved question about his past connection to them, hinting at forgotten memories or hidden ties.
source_quote: Somehow, you are very familiar.

subject: The Wizard Laboratory Under Emiry Meadows
fact: Spugnoir’s claim of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows introduces a new quest thread, pending verification and exploration.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.

subject: The Four Lost Chambers Beneath the Inn
fact: The rumor of four lost chambers beneath the Inn introduces a potential dungeon crawl and historical mystery, awaiting discovery.
source_quote: There is a secret passage below the inn that leads to an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.

subject: Lysia’s Quest to the Ruined Boathouse
fact: The farmer’s daughter Lysia’s desire to explore the ruined boathouse introduces a potential side quest involving equipment, companions, and possible dangers.
source_quote: a farmer's daughter, Lysia, is itching to explore the ruined boathouse, but she needs some equipment and a few competent companions.

subject: Tomorrow
fact: The trio and Spugnoir agree to begin their joint adventure tomorrow, marking the next phase of their journey.
source_quote: Tomorrow then, as it is quite late!
